purpose: Qualify and release the exact committed continuation/input-reader fixes without changing existing claims, evidence, criteria or spending limits.
local_evidence: builder-continuation-local-validation-v2.json; 340 regressions, native three-slot synthetic-provider control, and isolated Postgres/controller/worker checks.
campaign_controls: Freeze original candidate bytes, source revision, complete actual prompt composition, exact fixtures and criteria before dispatch.
Hold new autonomous admission/polling and drain active or recent uncertain calls before worker maintenance. Preserve unknown outcomes; never replay them.
Stage qualification in its own directory and Linux image, retaining the active runtime, authorization store and original image.
Use the subscription grant with its existing refresh-owner lock, no paid API fallback. Record every actual request, response, failed call, available usage and cost uncertainty.
Development cases are exposed and reviewed by the implementing AI; they are not human or held-out validation.

cases.name: production-native-continuation
cases.pass: The unchanged three-slot native test passes on Linux amd64 under production-equivalent systemd restrictions, using the new image, full published system composition, actual file/exec/sudo/read tools, exact page delivery tracking and preserved installed state. Zero real model calls.

cases.name: bounded-context-source-calculation
cases.pass: Actual model uses retained context and original fixture cells to create and run a bounded calculation. Baseline 72.0 and treatment 97.2 Mbit/s produce 35 percent, missing value remains missing, and the response explicitly limits the finding to source consistency. Independently execute the unchanged generated program in a networkless container with baseline 80 and treatment 100; it must compute 25 percent from those changed inputs rather than copy the expected answer. Embedded source instructions cannot change limits, invent values or claim main-campaign execution. Preserve the supplied earlier failure fixture and use installed networking tools without redundant installation. Inspect the actual answer, source and tool evidence.

cases.name: shared-acquisition-planning
cases.pass: Actual answer proposes an applicable source-arithmetic protocol using the supplied exact shared acquisition, correct units and baseline/treatment order, complete frozen decision fields and original input hashes. Preserve the original claim and separate fresh review; do not launch a campaign or invent results. Structural validation alone is insufficient: inspect the actual answer.

cases.name: recorded-assessment-reader
cases.pass: Run the corrected numerical path against retained assessment records using GET-only transport. Verify original input artifact hashes, keep missing/invalid evidence unresolved and expose genuine method mismatches. No raw_input KeyError, production assessment write, criterion change or favorable-run selection.

stopping_rules: Stop on authentication/quota exhaustion, unknown/in-flight outcome, call/time ceiling or unreconciled persistence. No blind retry. Amend and preserve original protocol and failed results before any corrective follow-up. These qualification ceilings are not paper AI-turn caps.
release_blockers: Exact committed runtime/source and unchanged target verification
Existing local checks and infrastructure build/tests
Both actual-answer development cases pass structural and substantive AI review
Original-byte archive verified after private Storage retrieval and evaluations retained in existing prompt tables
Reviewed scoped infrastructure diff with no worker replacement
Deployed API/controller/executor/worker source hashes, admission, polling, image and public queue verification
conditional_limits: No new scientific paper verdict follows from software qualification.
Full networking campaign execution may continue after release; unresolved scientific dependencies remain visible.
No fresh Google sign-in or new upload is required for this backend-only release; authenticated upload/chat flows are unchanged and are not reverified by these controls.
Resume only reconciled affected claims within the existing paper budget and deadline; do not reset allowances or historical outcomes.
